body:
C28 THE ATHLETE'S PURSE READ. Task file research/TASK_C28.md (read it and only the files it names). Model: Sonnet, effort medium, Fast off.

GymLedgerRead's sibling: new AthletePurseRead.gd + get_athlete_purse_read(athlete_id) beside get_gym_ledger_read() at GameState.gd:9616. Wallet now, career earnings, and the per-bout rows behind them from the settlement log rows at :10583. Every line carries source in {evidenced, invented, absent} - that is M8's shipped visual grammar, not decoration; a manager share that was never collectible is a present $0 row, never a missing one.

Name the logistics debit honestly: J6 A1 proved the opaque 'expenses' int is the fighter's own uncovered travel+accommodation, NOT a commission take, tax or gym cut. Pass R42's title_blocked_by_weight through so a blocked belt is not flattened. Missing keys on old rows read absent, never zero-that-looks-real.

REGION BOUNDARY: Claude holds the billing and settlement regions of GameState.gd for R44 this cycle - do not touch _apply_fight_result, _settle_billing, weekly_projection (:2842, :12285), GymLedgerRead.gd, FightContract.gd or Membership.gd. Your region is the read API around :9616-:9620 plus your own new file. R44 may land a named logistics key on the log row while you work: read it with a default and mark it absent when missing; do not wait on it and do not write it.

Parse gate then tests/athlete_purse_read_test.gd, then gym_ledger_read_test.gd and fight_log_test.gd, then the full suite once. Digest C28_DIGEST.md, append your own HANDOFF block, push master, message me.
